limitations: Converted SOL model, NOT tick-native SOL OHLC. GMGN native quote unavailable; saved USD token candles divided by historical Coinbase SOL/USD.
Entry FX is the last CLOSED 5-minute close known at signal; highSolProxy uses FX known at token-bar start, and closeSol uses FX known at bar end. Proxy highs are not exact native highs.
Initial signal-straddling bars and bars ending after UTC day end are excluded; no future FX, interpolation or invented fills.
TP high crossing is not executable liquidity. Target fills are capped and settled only at candle end, not exact fill times.
Unsold tokens are marked at last saved close but settle only at UTC day end; stale marks are flagged and do not establish realizable proceeds.
Fees, gas and slippage are editable MODEL assumptions, not actual receipts; gas is modeled 0.00005 SOL per transaction.
Curve equity is estimated cash plus held-token last-known marks, NOT liquidatable NAV; final balance is settled paper cash.
Signals compete for one total deposit, fixed 0.1 SOL ticket including entry costs, 0.01 SOL cash reserve; skipped entries are never retried.
Legacy and gap flags are retained; one closed day is not evidence of a validated edge.
